v1.title: frozen_v1 - PRIMARY PRE-FROZEN BENCHMARK
v1.caveat: Written before any evaluation was run. The only set a performance claim may be quoted from.

stress.title: frozen_v2 additions - ADVERSARIAL STRESS SET
stress.caveat: Written AFTER the first evaluation, from attack patterns and known failure modes. Measures robustness, not field accuracy.

combined.title: v1 + stress - COMBINED, STRESS EVALUATION ONLY
combined.caveat: NOT an unbiased frozen benchmark. Do not quote a single accuracy number from this set as a performance claim.
